# cpp-indexer graph schema — MCP system prompt
# DO NOT EDIT — generated by build.rs from src/schema/{nodes,edges,version}.rs
# schema-version: cxg-schema-v7

## Node kinds

Each node has a `kind` property (one of the values below) and a USR primary key.

### MODULE
A C++ translation unit or header treated as a logical module boundary.

### CLASS
A `class` or `struct` declaration.

### FUNCTION
A free function or static member function.

### METHOD
A non-static member function.

### FIELD
A non-static data member.

### GLOBAL_VARIABLE
A file-scope or namespace-scope variable (`extern`, `static`, plain).

### NAMESPACE
A named C++ namespace (`namespace foo { … }`).

### TEMPLATE_DECL
A class or function template declaration (not yet specialised).

### SPECIALIZATION
A concrete template specialization or instantiation.

### TYPEDEF
A `typedef` or `using` type alias.

### ENUM
An `enum` or `enum class` declaration.

### HEADER
A header file referenced via an `#include` directive.

### REPO
A source-code repository; one REPO node per indexed repo.

### MACRO
A preprocessor macro definition (`#define`).

### TYPE
A C++ type node (written-spelling deduped; ADR-2). USR: `type:<written-spelling>`.

### PARAMETER
A function/method parameter or template parameter. USR: `param:<owner-usr>:<index>`.

### TEMPLATE_ARG
A positional template argument node (ADR-5). USR: `targ:<specialization-usr>:<index>`. Carries param_index, param_kind, type_spelling; type-kind args also emit OF_TYPE to a Type node.

### CONCEPT
A C++20 concept declaration. USR: real libclang USR. Only emitted in C++20 mode (ADR-7).

### ENUMERATOR
A single enumeration constant within an enum or enum class. USR: real libclang USR. Carries enum_value (signed i64).

## Edge kinds

Edges connect nodes. Each edge has a `kind` property, `src_usr`, `dst_usr`, and optional `attrs_json`.

### CONTAINS
Lexical containment (e.g., class contains method, namespace contains class).

### HAS_METHOD
A class directly owns a method declaration.

### HAS_FIELD
A class directly owns a field declaration.

### INHERITS
Direct (non-virtual) or virtual base-class inheritance.

### USES
A type reference / type usage relationship (parameter type, return type, field type).

### CALLS
A direct call from one function/method to another.

### INCLUDES
A translation unit (MODULE) or header (HEADER) includes another header.

### OVERRIDES
A virtual method overrides a base-class virtual method; `vtable_slot` in attrs.

### INSTANTIATES
A call site or context that instantiates a template.

### SPECIALIZES
A template specialization refers to its primary template.

### FRIEND_OF
A class grants friend access to another entity.

### ADL_CANDIDATE
An unresolved name that is a candidate for Argument-Dependent Lookup.

### BELONGS_TO_REPO
Links every indexed node to its owning REPO node. Direction: (node)-[:BELONGS_TO_REPO]->(repo).

### EXTERNAL_REF
A cross-repository reference resolved during Phase 5. Direction: (src)-[:EXTERNAL_REF {via: <orig_edge_kind>}]->(dst).

### EXPANDS_TO
A top-level macro expansion at a call site. Direction: (call_site)-[:EXPANDS_TO]->(macro_def).

### RETURNS
A function/method returns a type. Direction: (Function|Method)-[:RETURNS]->(Type).

### HAS_PARAM
A function/method has a parameter (ordered by edge_index). Direction: (Function|Method)-[:HAS_PARAM {edge_index}]->(Parameter).

### OF_TYPE
A Parameter or Field has a type. Direction: (Parameter|Field)-[:OF_TYPE]->(Type).

### POINTS_TO
A pointer type points to its pointee type. Direction: (Type:ptr)-[:POINTS_TO]->(Type).

### REFERS_TO
A reference type refers to its referent type. Direction: (Type:ref)-[:REFERS_TO]->(Type).

### TEMPLATE_PARAM
A template definition has a template parameter (ordered). Direction: (TemplateDef)-[:TEMPLATE_PARAM {edge_index}]->(Parameter).

### TEMPLATE_ARG
A template specialization has a positional template argument (ADR-5). Direction: (Specialization)-[:TEMPLATE_ARG {edge_index}]->(TemplateArg).

### CONSTRAINED_BY
A template or parameter is constrained by a concept (C++20 only; ADR-7). Direction: (template_or_param)-[:CONSTRAINED_BY]->(Concept).

### ENUMERATOR_OF
An enumerator constant belongs to its parent enum. Direction: (Enumerator)-[:ENUMERATOR_OF]->(Enum).

### UNDERLYING_TYPE
An enum has an underlying integer type. Direction: (Enum)-[:UNDERLYING_TYPE]->(Type).

### ALIAS_OF
A typedef/type-alias is an alias for another type (one link per chain; ADR-2). Direction: (Typedef)-[:ALIAS_OF]->(Type).

### USES_NAMESPACE
A using-directive introduces a namespace into scope. Direction: (scope)-[:USES_NAMESPACE]->(Namespace).

### USES_DECLARATION
A using-declaration introduces a specific name from another scope. Direction: (scope)-[:USES_DECLARATION]->(symbol).

## Key node properties

- `usr` (string): global primary key from libclang (clang_getCursorUSR). For MACRO nodes, synthesised as `macro:<file>:<name>`.
- `kind` (string): one of the node kind names above.
- `name` (string): display name without qualification.
- `qualified_name` (string): fully-qualified name (e.g. `namespace::class::name`).
- `mangled_name` (string|null): ABI-mangled name; null when unavailable.
- `file_path` (string): absolute path to the defining source file.
- `line` (int|null): 1-based line number.
- `col` (int|null): 1-based column offset.
- `repo_name` (string): name of the owning repository.
- `attrs_json` (string): per-kind extra attributes as canonical JSON.
- `partial` (bool): true when the TU had libclang parse errors.
- `return_type` (string|null): type returned by a function or method.
- `params` (list|null): parameters for a function or method.
- `signature` (string|null): full function/method signature.
- `code` (string|null): source code snippet.
- `code_truncated` (bool|null): true if source code snippet was truncated.
- `template_params` (list|null): template parameters for template declarations.
- `template_args` (list|null): template arguments for specializations.
- `is_virtual` (bool|null): true if method is virtual.
- `is_pure_virtual` (bool|null): true if method is pure virtual.
- `is_static` (bool|null): true if function/method is static.
- `is_const` (bool|null): true if Field/GlobalVariable is const; null for other kinds.
- `is_constexpr` (bool|null): true if Field/GlobalVariable is constexpr; null for other kinds.
- `storage_class` (string|null): storage class of Field/GlobalVariable ("auto"|"static"|"extern"|"thread_local"|"register"|"none"); null for other kinds.
- `is_template` (bool|null): true if Function/Method/Class/TemplateDef is a template; null for other kinds.
- `is_noexcept` (bool|null): true if Function/Method is noexcept; null for other kinds.
- `is_override` (bool|null): true if Method is override; null for other kinds.
- `is_deleted` (bool|null): true if Function/Method is deleted; null for other kinds.
- `is_defaulted` (bool|null): true if Function/Method is defaulted; null for other kinds.
- `cv_qualifiers` (string|null): CV-qualifiers of Method ("const"|"volatile"|"const volatile"|empty); null for other kinds.
- `ref_qualifier` (string|null): ref-qualifier of Method ("&"|"&&"|empty); null for other kinds.
- `is_final` (bool|null): true if Class is final; null for other kinds.
- `is_abstract` (bool|null): true if Class is abstract; null for other kinds.
- `record_kind` (string|null): record kind of Class ("class"|"struct"|"union"); null for other kinds.
- `type_spelling` (string|null): written-spelling of the type for Type/Parameter/TemplateArg nodes; null for other kinds.
- `param_index` (int|null): 0-based parameter index for Parameter/TemplateArg nodes; null for other kinds.
- `param_kind` (string|null): parameter kind for Parameter/TemplateArg nodes ("type"|"non_type"|"template"|"value"); null for other kinds.
- `enum_value` (int|null): signed integer constant value for Enumerator nodes; null for other kinds.

## Key edge properties

- `src_usr` (string): source node USR.
- `dst_usr` (string|null): destination node USR; null when unresolved at emit time.
- `kind` (string): one of the edge kind names above.
- `resolved` (bool): true when dst_usr was found in the current repo's USR map.
- `cross_repo_candidate` (bool): true when dst_usr is absent from the current repo's map.
- `attrs_json` (string): edge attributes as canonical JSON (vtable_slot, access, virtual, via…).
- `source_association_type` (string|null): source-side access classification for USES edges.
- `target_association_type` (string|null): target-side access classification for USES edges.
- `access` (string|null): C++ access specifier on HasMethod/HasField/Inherits edges ("public"|"protected"|"private"); null for other kinds.
- `edge_index` (int|null): ordering index for HAS_PARAM/TEMPLATE_PARAM/TEMPLATE_ARG edges; null for other kinds.
- `inherits_is_virtual` (bool|null): true when Inherits edge is virtual inheritance; null for other kinds.
